test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
L is the daughter of H. H is married to K. K is the mother of I. I is the father of J. J is married to M. M is the sister of N.

How is J related to H?
solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d51148a9fb59af97031345db3a8efa0848604947cdf72248e2785c541c33557c.png] 

As per the given information:

1. L is the daughter of H and H is married to K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dd05fe8ca65e6c42939882756f81a9cdaca8dfeaa2344045dc06c807f2f12624.png] 

2. K is the mother of I and I is the father of J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b0416dcbe0b5824e1761aad1daeeee024c08c68ea5ebb5b85c3dec1f8bf8e34.png] 

3. J is married to M. M is the sister of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0cb58a84ce744e457931d2a4c638ddfd3e5e6fd4f03a29524b36549bcc777d3.png] 

Here, 'J' is the son's son of H.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (3)".
